name: North Dakota
source: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner, 2026 Forms ND-1/ND-EZ tax rate schedules printed in Form ND-1ES 2026 (https://www.tax.nd.gov/sites/www/files/documents/forms/individual/2025-iit/28709-form-nd-1es-2026.pdf, read in validation run 2, 2026-10-22): 0%, 1.95% and 2.5%, with separate tables for single, joint and separate returns; Tax Foundation 2026 state income tax table and TaxAct North Dakota guide agree on the rates

state_base.note: North Dakota starts from federal adjusted (or taxable) income and keeps the federal treatment of 401(k) deferrals, Traditional IRA deposits and HSA deposits (no add-back; only California and New Jersey tax HSA deposits). Not checked against a state ruling.

standard_deduction.note: North Dakota starts from federal taxable income, so the federal 2026 standard deduction applies (16,100 single and separate / 32,200 joint; Tax Foundation 2026 footnote). Brackets: the 2026 rate schedules of Form ND-1ES 2026 (single 49,575 / 250,400, joint 82,800 / 304,850, separate 41,400 / 152,425; https://www.tax.nd.gov/sites/www/files/documents/forms/individual/2025-iit/28709-form-nd-1es-2026.pdf, confirmed primary, validation run 2, 2026-10-22). Not modelled: the federal 6,000 senior deduction.

exemptions.note: No exemptions; senior is the federal additional standard deduction for 65 or older (1,650 married) carried in through federal taxable income.

capital_gains_exclusion.note: 40% of net long-term capital gains is excluded (N.D.C.C. 57-38-01.8; ND-1 line 7 worksheet and the ICI state tax survey agree, confirmed primary: https://www.tax.nd.gov/sites/www/files/documents/forms/individual/2025-iit/2025-individual-income-tax-booklet.pdf, validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

estate_inheritance.note: North Dakota has no estate tax and no inheritance tax (Tax Foundation 2026 estate and inheritance tax map and state-costs.csv columns estate_tax and inheritance_tax agree). Confirmed primary on https://www.tax.nd.gov/estate-tax (validation run 3, 2026-10-22).

social_security.note: North Dakota exempts Social Security benefits (subtraction of the federally taxed amount;AARP North Dakota tax guide and state-costs.csv ss_taxed 'N' agree). Pensions and IRA distributions are taxed. Confirmed primary on https://www.tax.nd.gov/sites/www/files/documents/forms/individual/2025-iit/2025-individual-income-tax-booklet.pdf (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner (no local income tax)
local_income_tax.note: North Dakota has no local income taxes (Tax Foundation local income tax list and state-costs.csv local_income_tax agree).

sales_tax.check_at: North Dakota revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: 0.05 from the state's own source (North Dakota motor vehicle excise 5% of the price, no local tax (N.D.C.C. 57-40.3-02, https://www.ndlegis.gov/cencode/t57c40-3.pdf, validation run 2)). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: no); research note: Food exempt from state and local. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.source: NDDOT Passenger Fee Schedule MVD-2 (10-2025), effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, read 2026-10-23: 3,200 to 4,499 lb first registered 2018 to 2020, 81 a year (93 if first registered 2021 or later, 57 if 2014 or earlier)
car_taxes.note: Floor: the registration fee of a mid-weight passenger car first registered 2018 to 2020. North Dakota has no vehicle property tax. Set by hand (s328, 2026-10-23, owner decision C4: no 0 that only means unknown); a move changes the entered car tax by the dollar difference of the two states' figures, and the importer keeps a non-zero figure.

fuel.source: Excise: https://www.tax.nd.gov/business/motor-fuel-tax (validation run 2, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.23 ($0.23 per gallon); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, North Dakota insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Research note: MA premium 0.00 in source; suspect, check CMS landscape. The source gives a Medicare Advantage premium of 0.00 here, which is suspect, so it is null. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
